caseName: Hughes v. State Board of Medical Examiners
caseNameFull: Hughes v. State Board of Medical Examiners and Hughes v. State Board of Medical Examiners
attorneys: Messrs. Norman I. Miller and George. C. Spence, with whom Mr. George P. Whitman was. on the brief, for plaintiff in error., Mr. J. Z. Foster for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The writs of error are dismised for want of a substantial federal question on the authority of Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 569; Hull v. Burr, 234 U. S. 712, 720; Norton v. Whiteside, 239 U. S. 144, 147.
